curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42079-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds the forklift, its functions on pages 118-119); book 2, omr/instructions/42079-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate tow truck

functions.does: Turning the orange beacon on the cab roof raises and lowers the forks: its upright shaft turns bevel gears and an 8 tooth gear under the floor, and a shaft with two universal joints runs forward into the mast, where a rack lifts the inner mast and a string over a pulley at its top lifts the fork carriage further.
functions.source: book 1: steps 19-23 (the centre gearbox), 109-113 (the mast and its rack), 194 (the string); page 118 (top left photo, the arrows on the beacon and the forks)

functions.does: The lever on the side of the body tilts the mast forward and back.
functions.source: book 1: page 118 (bottom left photo, the arrows on the side lever and the mast); the lever's build steps are inferred

functions.does: The grey exhaust stack on top at the back steers the rear wheels.
functions.source: book 1: page 119 (bottom right photo, the arrows on the exhaust and the rear wheel)

functions.does: Pushed along, the front wheels drive the two cylinder engine through a differential: a shaft runs back to the engine, where a 16 tooth gear and an idler turn the crankshaft and the two pistons move up and down.
functions.source: book 1: steps 27-30 (the differential), 76-83 (the engine); page 119 (top right photo, the arrows on the pistons)

functions.does: The rear wheels roll freely; they aren't driven.
functions.source: inferred: no drive shaft reaches the rear axle

functions.does: The two front wheel arches, with the mirrors, swing out.
functions.source: inferred: each arch hangs on its own pin (wheelarchfrontleft and right); the book draws no arrow on them
functions.note: unsure whether the arches are meant to move
